playgrounds.title: Playgrounds report
playgrounds.requirements: A volunteer is required to monitor at least 3 playgrounds and devote at least 10 hours to this every week.
playgrounds.whats-new:
The form for filling out reports has been unified for volunteers of all Russian Diaspora programs. Now the site monitoring report must be filled out and sent only once a week, information about all 3 sites must be entered into one report.
There is no need to fill out a route sheet.

1.title: Go to the report creation page
1.link: Follow this link or via the side menu

2.title: Fill in the Excel file using the template
2.link: You can download the template by link
2.hint:
Copy the file to yourself File - Make a copy.
Fill in the table and download as .xlsx file File - Download

3.title: Enter information about three playgrounds
3.fields:
In the Name field, specify the name of the site, for example Playground in Šumice Park. In the Description field, fill in your detailed comment on the playground. In the Result field, enter the link to the playground on Google Maps. The Customer field is not required.
The total number of hours spent across all playgrounds must be at least 10.
Please attach a photo of the playground and a completed Excel file with the playground parameters to the files.

4.title: All is ready!
4.hint: Don't forget to click the Submit button
